steps: Run npm run build
Run npm run serve and open localhost:4173
Compare rendered UI to previous behavior across desktop and mobile

Call /api/weather?lat=-26.3&lon=31.2 and confirm live weather response
Confirm dev proxy works via npm run dev

Confirm %VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY% resolves in dist/
Confirm maps load with a real key in .env

description: Screenshot baselines exist for all screens on desktop and mobile
steps: Run npx playwright test
Verify 14 baselines exist in tests/baselines/
Baselines match current UI (login + 6 app screens x 2 viewports)

description: Lint and typecheck gates pass and are wired to npm scripts
steps: Run npm run lint — exit 0
Run npm run typecheck — exit 0
Run npm test — all green

description: Phase 1 complete: index.html fully modularized (CSS via src/styles, all JS in public/modules/*), zero inline scripts; repaired modules execute cleanly with unit+smoke gates

node --test: 20/20 pass (AIUtil, AIMemory, AIEmotion, DB_PRO, db-pro globals)
npx playwright test --config playwright.smoke.mjs: 6/6 screens, no runtime errors, all module globals defined

description: Auth API: signup, login, logout, session restore (GET /me), password reset — Argon2id hashing, SHA-256 session tokens, HttpOnly cookies
steps: POST /api/v1/auth/signup with valid email+password+name returns 201 + session cookie
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 + session cookie
POST /api/v1/auth/logout clears session cookie
GET /api/v1/auth/me with valid session returns user; without returns 401
POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password returns dev token (email flow placeholder)

description: RBAC middleware: requireAuth + requireRole preHandler hooks; admin routes gated behind super_admin/admin
steps: Unauthenticated request to /admin/v1/* returns 401
Regular user (role: user) request to /admin/v1/* returns 403
Admin user (role: admin) request to /admin/v1/* returns 200

description: Admin Users CRUD: list/search, inspect, suspend/unsuspend, reset password, soft-delete, subscription tier override — all audit-logged
steps: GET /admin/v1/users returns paginated user list
GET /admin/v1/users/:id returns user + profile
PATCH /admin/v1/users/:id/suspend sets status=suspended + audit log
PATCH /admin/v1/users/:id/unsuspend restores status=active
POST /admin/v1/users/:id/reset-password hashes new password + revokes sessions
PATCH /admin/v1/users/:id/subscription-tier upserts profile.subscriptionTier
PATCH /admin/v1/users/:id/soft-delete sets status=deleted (super_admin protected)

description: Admin Config: feature flags CRUD + app config CRUD — toggle keys, set jsonb values, all audit-logged
steps: GET /admin/v1/flags returns all feature flags
PATCH /admin/v1/flags/:key creates or updates a flag (enabled, description)
GET /admin/v1/config returns all config entries
PATCH /admin/v1/config/:key creates or updates a config value

description: Admin Panel: vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SPA at /admin, dark theme, login overlay, tabbed UI (Users/Flags/Config), audit-logged mutations
steps: GET /admin returns self-contained HTML with login overlay
Login with admin credentials shows panel with tabs
Users tab: list users with role/status badges, suspend/unsuspend buttons
Flags tab: list flags with toggle switches
Config tab: list config entries

description: Health mask: /api/v1/health does not expose db status; /api/v1/health/detail exposes full health info
steps: GET /api/v1/health returns ok, service, version, uptimeSec — no db field
GET /api/v1/health/detail returns ok, service, version, uptimeSec, db status

description: DB migration: 0000_jazzy_king_cobra.sql generated for 7 tables (users, sessions, profiles, settings, audit_logs, feature_flags, app_config)
steps: npm run db:generate produces migration SQL
npm run db:migrate applies migration to Postgres
Verify all 7 tables exist with correct columns

description: Admin E2E gate: RBAC role enforcement (unauthenticated/user/admin), per-entity CRUD (users, flags, config), audit-log assertions
steps: npm run test:admin runs tests/unit/admin-e2e.test.mjs
RBAC: unauthenticated→401, user→403, super_admin→200 on all /admin/v1/*
Users: list, inspect, suspend/unsuspend, soft-delete, reset-password, subscription tier
Flags: create, update, list
Config: create, update, list, validation
Audit: every mutation writes to audit_logs with actorId, before/after

description: Weather proxy in Fastify pipeline with SSRF allow-list (api.openweathermap.org only), 5s timeout, env key server-side
steps: GET /api/weather?lat=X&lon=Y returns live weather data
SSRF: non-allowed host rejected with 400
Missing OPENWEATHER_API_KEY returns 500
Upstream timeout returns 502

description: Profile/settings write-through sync: server API (GET/PUT /api/v1/me/profile, /api/v1/me/settings) with localStorage as offline cache
steps: GET /api/v1/me/profile returns user profile (auth required)
PUT /api/v1/me/profile updates displayName/bio/avatarUrl
GET /api/v1/me/settings returns settings payload
PUT /api/v1/me/settings merges new settings into payload
Client: darkMode/themeAccent/aiPersonality/profile saves use write-through (server + localStorage)

description: Offline-cache migration: zero direct localStorage touches in public/modules/* (all via offline-cache-global shim)
steps: Grep public/modules/* for localStorage. — 0 matches
node --check passes on all 10 edited modules + shim
npm run build succeeds; UI behavior identical (no keys/formats changed)

description: Channels ownership fix: generic entity CRUD maps channels to createdBy instead of userId

Admin entities list with userId filter maps to createdBy for channels
npm run db:migrate + seed on live Postgres, then test:admin green

description: Admin Entities tab: per-entity list/search/inspect/override/suspend + deals approve-reject + sync-health in panel

List tasks, search, inspect a record, override-edit a field
Suspend/restore a bulletin; approve/reject a deal; audit log shows before/after

Authenticated image upload returns {url}; GET url serves the file
